meta.basis: The Ember Days' prayer 'for the preservation of the fruits of the earth' (Catechism of St. Pius X, part III, ch. IV, q. 23) at spring sowing, kept with Mass in violet (Divinum Officium's liturgical_color: 'Quadragesimæ'). The Universal Norms (nos. 45–47) keep the same intention for the Ember Days in the new calendar, with a Mass for Various Needs such as 'At Seedtime'.
